version: R02-G: exact Gaussian log-intensity reference, not a Poisson-count forecast
geometry: 512 Fibonacci directions; retain z>0.55 OR (z< -0.4 AND x>0)
science_model: log intensity = log normalization + n.d + selection T.eta + Gaussian measurement noise + Gaussian correlated sky
selection: log efficiency = log(0.4)+T.eta; T=[x,P2(z),x*z], eta=[0.02,0.03,-0.02]; finite 32 separate full-sky calibration directions with Gaussian noisy log-efficiency observations
calibration: 32 independent observations regenerated per replicate; standard deviation 0.01 or 0.05; no truth eta is supplied to estimator
noise: science independent standard deviation 0.04; correlated-sky modes [x,y,z] each standard deviation 0.008 in declared correlated strata
estimator: joint generalized least squares for [log normalization,dx,dy,dz,eta_x,eta_quad,eta_xz]; fixed analytic block covariance; nuisance and normalization fitted
region: one fixed 95% joint three-dimensional Gaussian ellipsoid using fitted dipole and its marginal covariance; threshold chi-square dimension 3 quantile; no truth-indexed calibration
negative_controls: same correlated samples analyzed ignoring sky covariance; independent calibration systematically offset by +0.03*x; no calibration leaves x dipole nonidentifiable
scope: fixed synthetic Gaussian likelihood and known noise scales only; sky target deterministic d, random sky marginalized; no public preregistration, actual survey, significance claim or cosmological ranking
